title: PostgreSQL 18 vs 19
machines: One server with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 16 GB, postgres:18.7 vs postgres:19.0, same settings, JIT off on both
metric: median of 5 runs (3 for autovacuum and table rewrites); for ms rounds lower is better, for tps rounds higher is better

rounds.round: COPY 5M rows into a table with a foreign key (ms)
INSERT … SELECT 5M rows with a foreign key (ms)
Single-row inserts with a foreign key, 16 clients (tps)
NOT IN with 1M rows in the subquery (ms)
Lowest tps while removing bloat: VACUUM FULL on 18, REPACK (CONCURRENTLY) on 19
Autovacuum on a table with 8 indexes (ms)
